title: ProductConsumedState - Data API
description: Represents the status of an item from your inventory that was used to complete a work order or work order line item in Field Service. This object is available in API version 57.0 and later.

ConsumedState.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ConsumedState.description: The new state of the serialized product after it’s consumed

IsLocked.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsLocked.description: Indicates whether the product consumed record is locked or not. The default value is false.

MayEdit.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
MayEdit.description: Indicates whether the product consumed record can be edited or not. The default value is false.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

ProductConsumedId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
ProductConsumedId.description: The Product Consumed that is used for consuming the serialized products

SerializedProductId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update

special_access_rules:
Field Service must be enabled.

To create products consumed, you need Read permission on product items.

To delete products consumed, you need Edit, Create, and Read permission on product items.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as ProductConsumedState.

- **Product Consumed State History**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
